message.reasoning:
We need to generate a comprehensive JUnit 4 test file covering all public methods: constructor, clone, serialize (two overloads), deserialize (two overloads). Also need to test ClassLoaderAwareObjectInputStream indirectly via clone (since it's private static class). Provide tests for normal behavior, edge cases (null inputs, empty objects, custom classloader failures). Also test that serialize throws IllegalArgumentException for null outputStream, deserialize throws IllegalArgumentException for null inputStream or null byte array. Test that clone returns null when input null. Test that serialization of non-serializable throws SerializationException? Actually methods accept Serializable, so compile-time; but we can pass a class that implements Serializable but throws exception during writeObject? Could create one that throws NotSerializableException? Actually NotSerializableException occurs when class doesn't implement Serializable; compile fails. But we can create a class that implements Serializable but its writeObject throws IOException. That's possible via custom writeObject method.

Also test that ClassLoaderAwareObjectInputStream's resolveClass fallback works: we can create a class loaded by a custom classloader that is not the default, then serialize with that classloader? Might be complex. Simpler: we can create a custom class loader that cannot load a class, then clone using that class's classloader? Actually clone uses object's class loader to create ClassLoaderAwareObjectInputStream. For fallback, we need scenario where classLoader cannot find class, causing ClassNotFoundException, then fallback to thread context class loader which can. To simulate, we can create a subclass of ClassLoader that always throws ClassNotFoundException for any class. Then set thread context classloader to current loader. Then clone an object; during deserialization, ClassLoaderAwareObjectInputStream will try classLoader (the dummy) fails, then fallback to Thread context classloader (which can load). So we can test that clone works even with failing classloader.

Edge case for serialize where object is null: method writes null; deserialization returns null. Should test that.

Also test that serialize to OutputStream with null outputStream throws IllegalArgumentException.

Also test that deserialize(InputStream) with null throws IllegalArgumentException.

Also test deserialize(byte[]) with null throws IllegalArgumentException.

Also test that close exceptions are ignored (hard to test). Not needed.

Make tests using JUnit 4 annotations: @Test, @Before, @After. Use assertEquals, assertSame, assertNotSame, assertArrayEquals, etc.

Define a simple Serializable class (SimpleBean) with fields.

Define a Serializable class with custom writeObject throwing IOException (FaultySerializable) to test SerializationException.

Define a custom ClassLoader that fails to load any class.

Implement tests.

Now produce final answer with test file starting with ###Test START## and ending with ###Test END##. Provide imports, class definition, test methods.
